title: Sultan bin Salman Thanks Leadership for Approving Comprehensive Access Program for People with Disabilities
summary: Sultan bin Salman expressed gratitude to the Saudi leadership for the approval of a comprehensive access program designed to improve accessibility and inclusion for people with disabilities.
body:
Sultan bin Salman expressed gratitude to the Saudi leadership for the approval of a comprehensive access program designed to improve accessibility and inclusion for people with disabilities.
